public abstract class Seq<A>
  extends Aggregate<A>
The basic aggregate class of sequences. This abstract class is superclass of diverse implementation variants of sequences.

Version: $Id: Seq.pizza,v 1.3 1997/11/09 23:03:00 wg Exp $

IndexOutOfBoundsException - if start index not in [0..size()-1], or end index not in [0..size()]
